! Game text
| '''0 side — I Want That Map'''<br />''Deploy Tuanul Village, any other [Episode VII] location, and I Will Finish What You Started. Opponent may reveal a unique (•) Resistance character from Reserve Deck; that card is a Resistance Agent. Otherwise, Luke is a Resistance Agent and loses immunity to attrition.'' '''For''' remainder of game, non-[Episode VII] Dark Jedi are lost and Resistance Agents are immune to Set For Stun. '''Flip''' this card if your First Order characters control two battlegrounds and a Resistance Agent is not present at a battleground site.<br />'''7 side — And Now You'll Give It To Me'''<br />'''While''' this side up, where you have a First Order leader, opponent must first use or lose 1 Force to draw a card for battle destiny. Unless BB-8 on table, opponent's Force retrieval is canceled. If Kylo on table: During your turn, may stack an Interrupt from your Lost Pile face up on I Will Finish What You Started; and once per turn, may play an Interrupt stacked there as if from hand (then place that card out of play). '''Flip''' this card if you do not occupy two battlegrounds or if a Resistance Agent is present at a battleground site. || '''0 side — I Want That Map'''<br />''Deploy Tuanul Village, any other [Episode VII] location, and I Will Finish What You Started. Opponent may reveal a unique (•) ''{{Errata hl|1=''Resistance''}}'' character from Reserve Deck; that card is a Resistance Agent. Otherwise, Luke is a Resistance Agent and loses immunity to attrition.'' '''For''' remainder of game, non-[Episode VII] Dark Jedi are lost and Resistance Agents are immune to Set For Stun. '''Flip''' this card if your First Order characters control two battlegrounds and a Resistance Agent is not present at a battleground site.<br />'''7 side — And Now You'll Give It To Me'''<br />'''While''' this side up, where you have a First Order leader, opponent must first use or lose 1 Force to draw a card for battle destiny. Unless BB-8 on table, opponent's Force retrieval is canceled. If Kylo on table: During your turn, may stack an Interrupt from your Lost Pile face up on I Will Finish What You Started; and once per turn, may play an Interrupt stacked there as if from hand (then place that card out of play). '''Flip''' this card if you do not occupy two battlegrounds or if a Resistance Agent is present at a battleground site. || '''0 side — I Want That Map'''<br />''Deploy Tuanul Village, any other [Episode VII] location, and I Will Finish What You Started. Opponent may reveal a unique (•) character ''{{Errata hl|1=''with ability (except Luke or a Jedi)''}}'' from Reserve Deck; that card is a Resistance Agent. Otherwise, Luke is a Resistance Agent and loses immunity to attrition.'' '''For''' remainder of game, non-[Episode VII] Dark Jedi are lost and Resistance Agents are immune to Set For Stun. '''Flip''' this card if your First Order characters control two battlegrounds and a Resistance Agent is not present at a battleground site.<br />'''7 side — And Now You'll Give It To Me'''<br />'''While''' this side up, where you have a First Order leader, opponent must first use or lose 1 Force to draw a card for battle destiny. Unless BB-8 on table, opponent's Force retrieval is canceled. If Kylo on table: During your turn, may stack an Interrupt from your Lost Pile face up on I Will Finish What You Started; and once per turn, may play an Interrupt stacked there as if from hand (then place that card out of play). '''Flip''' this card if you do not occupy two battlegrounds or if a Resistance Agent is present at a battleground site.

== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Modern [[I Want That Map / And Now You'll Give It To Me]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Words a later column removed are highlighted in the column before it. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[I Want That Map / And Now You'll Give It To Me (Errata 2)]] shares the [[I Want That Map / And Now You'll Give It To Me (Errata)]] column; [[I Want That Map / And Now You'll Give It To Me (Errata 4)]] shares the [[I Want That Map / And Now You'll Give It To Me (Errata 3)]] column; [[I Want That Map / And Now You'll Give It To Me (Errata 5)]] shares the [[I Want That Map / And Now You'll Give It To Me (Errata 3)]] column; [[I Want That Map / And Now You'll Give It To Me (Errata 6)]] shares the [[I Want That Map / And Now You'll Give It To Me (Errata 3)]] column. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
